sources.text: 손잡이 없는 도자기 컵을 원해요. 색상은 파란색이나 내추럴 모두 괜찮고, 식기세척기에 넣을 수 있으면 좋겠어요.
Me gustaría el cuenco de gres de 650 ml para desayunar. Solo lo compraría con acabado satinado, no brillante.
Je voudrais le pot en grès avec un trou de drainage et sa soucoupe. La couleur bleue ou naturelle me convient.

translations.englishGloss: I want a ceramic cup without a handle. Either blue or natural is fine, and I would like it to be dishwasher-safe.
I would like the 650 ml stoneware bowl for breakfast. I would only buy it with a satin finish, not glossy.
I would like the stoneware pot with a drainage hole and its saucer. Blue or natural works for me.
